§6Basic Ores§f

§aTime to go mining for some new metals!§f

Thermal Foundation adds §e9§f metal ores: Copper, Tin, Silver, Lead, Aluminum, Nickel, Platinum, Iridium, and Mana Infused (Mithril). The first six mine with stone-tier pickaxes; Platinum, Iridium, and Mithril need diamond.

Smelt ores 1:1 for ingots, or run them through the §bPulverizer§f for §e2x§f dust output. The §bInduction Smelter§f gives §e2§f ingots from ore + sand, and adding Rich Slag or Cinnabar bumps that to §e3§f. Cinnabar comes from processing Redstone in the Pulverizer, so keep an eye out for it.

§ePS:§f A Smashing-enchanted pickaxe drops §e2x§f pulverized metal directly, no machine needed.
